behavior: harness/model-map.json exists, parses, and carries all seven declared blocks
verification: python3 -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(open("harness/model-map.json")); need={"$comment","version","pools","harnesses","tiers","chains","services"}; sys.exit(1 if need-set(d) else 0)'

behavior: the shipped map validates against the shipped schema
verification: cd cli && go test -count=1 ./internal/harness/ -run '^TestModelMapValidatesAgainstSchema$' -v 2>&1 | grep -q -- '--- PASS: TestModelMapValidatesAgainstSchema '

behavior: the schema rejects a harness referencing a pool absent from pools
verification: cd cli && go test -count=1 ./internal/harness/ -run '^TestSchemaRejectsDanglingPoolReference$' -v 2>&1 | grep -q -- '--- PASS: TestSchemaRejectsDanglingPoolReference '

behavior: no retired provider (openrouter, codex) is declared as a pool or harness, or referenced by one — structural, not textual: the $comment names both on purpose
